name: ircode
description: Identify exact images and find out more about them, or make your own image scannable and link it to your site.

interface.longDescription:
IRCODE identifies specific images. Show it a picture, poster, painting, product shot or ad, and it tells you which registered image it is and what information is known about it: the title, creator, links and details.

IRCODE's database grows every day, and if something isn't recognized yet, you can add it yourself. Register an image and anyone who points a phone at it, or asks their assistant about it, gets the title and link you attached. There is no QR code or overlay; the picture itself becomes the code. Sign in to make your registrations permanent and manage them on ircode.app, and even register a video so every part of it is recognizable.

Things to ask:
- "Ask IRCODE what this is" with a photo attached
- "Use IRCODE to make this image scannable and link it to my site"
capabilities: Identifies a specific registered image and returns what its owner published
Registers an image with a title and link so it becomes scannable
Registers a whole video so every frame is recognizable (if signed in)
Keeps registrations in your IRCODE account (if signed in)
Looks up an IRCODE by its ID
defaultPrompt: What is this image, and who published it?
Make my poster scannable and link it to my website

publication.release_notes: Signing in is now optional: scanning and lookup work without an IRCODE account, and sign-in is asked for only to keep a registration or register a video.
